sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection II, 
 to be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block or when filter differential pressure is greater than 15 PSI.
Main lube oil Filter function to clean oil from impurities and dirty.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Ahmed Badawy, reviewed by eng. 
 Mohamed Moussa Embaby, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Abouda EL Bana, 
 and accepted by eng. Mahmoud Abdel Hady Ahmed general 
 director.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety Category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust 
 cover" ... etc
Turbine must be shutdown.
Ensure that the inlet and outlet valves are closed
Drain the filter.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Rags, Cleaning Fluid.
Close inlet and outlet valves.

Open Drain and vent valves to drain filter 
 completely before removing Cartridges.
Untight the filter cover bolts.
Remove cover and old filter Cartridge.
Clean thoroughly the filter internal surface
Insert new filter Cartridge
Clean cover gasket and gasket seat
Replace new gasket if it is hard or damage

sections.text: Reassembly and Pushing Filter in Service
Place the filter cover and tight the cover bolts
Open vent to release air and close it when oil appears.
Observe the differential pressure gauge reading less than 15Psi
